title: Prove a MoE retuning no-go
objective: Determine whether one MoE GEMM is already close enough to its attainable read/copy floor that configuration retuning should stop.
preconditions: Exact production fused W13 or W2 contract
Measured attainable bandwidth floor on the target GPU
steps: Measure baseline bytes, launch count, and latency
Compare attainable utilization rather than theoretical peak only
Try at most one causally bounded library/config set

acceptance.no_go: Remaining headroom is smaller than the target plus uncertainty and the bounded set fails.
acceptance.continue: A mechanism removes bytes, a launch, or a fusion boundary rather than retuning the same work.

stop_rule: Do not continue block-size or physical-constant tuning after the attainable floor proves the target impossible.
origin_evidence: Reviewed W13 reached 83.918% versus an 83.93% read ceiling; W2 was about 99.26% of its attainable floor.
